description: The hypermodern flank opening: White develops the knight first and challenges the center with 2.c4. Black accepts the gambit with 2...dxc4, and White regains the pawn with e3 and Bxc4, building a solid center. Both sides castle into a rich positional struggle.

lines.description: After 1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 dxc4, White plays 3.e3 Nf6 4.Bxc4 e6. White castles 5.O-O, Black strikes back 5...c5. White builds the center 6.d4 Nc6 7.Nc3 cxd4 8.exd4 Be7 9.h3 O-O. White has the bishop pair and central space; Black is solid and ready to challenge.
